Re-examining: pick 3 Rays +119 W, pick 5 Wings +200 W, pick 6 ARI +118 W, pick 8 BUF +125 W, pick 13 BUF +137 W, pick 12 MIN +190 L, pick 17 BOS +114 L. That's 5-2 on plus-money dogs with model edge. Reasonable tentative pattern.

AgentMemory.rule: Heavy NBA home favorites (-170 or shorter) with large net-rating gaps are underperforming despite model showing 10%+ edges. Pick 10 (Detroit -174 vs CLE) lost, and similar large-favorite NBA spots warrant reduced stake or pass. Net rating differentials alone don't account for injury/rotation noise on favored side.
AgentMemory.reasoning: Pick 10 Detroit -174 with +19 net rating gap lost. Pick 18 (Detroit -184 with same teams) is pending but model flagged DET injuries (Huerter, Robinson, LeVert DTD). Two data points only — weight low until more evidence.

AgentMemory.rule: NBA player props (OVER points) with rolling-mean projections are running roughly break-even (2-2 in sample: Reid 13.5 W, Vassell 12.5 L, Reid 12.5 L, Fox 17.5 W). Despite model showing 10-17% edges, hit rate isn't matching projection. Cap stake on prop OVERs to <=¼ Kelly and require opponent factor >1.08 AND recent form showing 4+ of 5 games clearing the line.
AgentMemory.reasoning: Picks 9, 14, 15, 16 — small sample 2-2. Modest signal that prop OVER edges may be overstated by model. Aligns with existing memory #2 about prop_nba underperforming at scale (38% win rate across 1123 outcomes).

AgentMemory.rule: Plus-money model-edge moneyline picks (+105 to +270) continue to outperform: in this batch picks 3, 5, 6, 8, 13, 22, 24, 25, 26, 27 won at plus money while 12, 17, 21, 23, 28 lost — roughly 10-5 (67%) across recent sample. When model edge >=7% AND independent confirmation exists (net rating gap >=10 in basketball, pitcher-quality gap in MLB, or large bookSpread >=20 cents on the opposite side), lean in at moderate stake. Avoid plus-money picks where the only signal is the model snapshot.
AgentMemory.reasoning: Refining existing rule #4 with expanded evidence: 10-5 across 15 plus-money picks. Notable losers (17 BOS+114, 21 WAS+160, 23 DET+140, 28 PIT+136) lacked strong independent confirmation. Winners often had bookSpread signals or large net-rating gaps.

AgentMemory.rule: Large bookSpread on the opposite side (>=25 cents, or 200+ cents in extreme cases) is a strong independent confirmation signal. Picks where the opposing side shows extreme book disagreement won at high rate: pick 4 NYK (207c spread on PHI), pick 5 DAL (30c on home), pick 24 DAL (209c on CHI home), pick 26 TOR (25c on TOR side) — all wins. Use bookSpread as a tier-1 confirming factor per rule #2.
AgentMemory.reasoning: 4 of 4 picks citing extreme bookSpread as a signal won. Small sample but consistent, and provides the kind of independent market-disagreement signal that rule #2 demands.

AgentMemory.rule: Do NOT auto-trust the 'Skenes pitching edge' narrative for Pirates picks. Despite Skenes' reputation, recent Skenes-start Pirates picks are mixed (pick 2 W at -114, pick 28 L at +136). When Pirates are road dogs at plus money with Skenes, require additional confirmation (opponent offense weakness, bookSpread signal) rather than treating ace-pitcher identity as sufficient edge.
AgentMemory.reasoning: Pick 28 used Skenes as the primary independent-confirmation lever per rule #2 and lost. Two-data-point caution, but ace-pitcher narratives are a known overweighted bias.

AgentMemory.rule: WNBA moneyline picks with double-digit net-rating gaps are converting strongly: picks 5, 7, 20, 24, 26 all won (5-1 including pick 21 loss). When net rating differential exceeds 15 points AND either plus-money is available OR bookSpread signals disagreement, the WNBA model is producing reliable edges despite being flagged uncalibrated. Stake at standard size, don't shrink to ¼ Kelly solely on the uncalibrated flag.
AgentMemory.reasoning: 5 of 6 WNBA picks won in this sample, several at substantial plus money (+200, +270). The uncalibrated flag may be over-discounting genuine edges in this league.

AgentMemory.rule: Pitcher-quality narrative as the SOLE independent confirmation for plus-money MLB dogs is unreliable. Recent picks invoking 'ace SP edge' (Skenes vs Corbin pick 28, McClanahan vs Bradish pick 33, Strider-fade pick 17, Rasmussen pick 30) went 0-4. Require at least one additional non-pitcher signal (bookSpread >=15c, large rpg/oppRpg gap >=1.5, or recent team form) before backing an MLB dog on starter-quality grounds alone.
AgentMemory.reasoning: Picks 17, 28, 30, 33 all leaned heavily on starter-quality gap as the rule #2 independent confirmation and all lost. This extends and generalizes existing memory #9 beyond Skenes/Pirates to any 'ace pitcher' narrative in MLB.

AgentMemory.rule: Large net-rating gap (>=15 points) on moneyline picks is the most reliable independent confirmation signal across leagues. Picks 4 (NYK +13.5 gap W), 7 (IND +18.5 W), 20 (LV +22.5 W), 24 (DAL +18 W), 27 (NYK +16 W), 29 (NYK +17.75 W) all won. Pick 10/18 (DET +15-19 gap vs CLE) lost — exception was an NBA home favorite at heavy chalk (-174/-184), which aligns with the heavy-home-favorite leak pattern. Treat >=15 net-rating gap as tier-1 confirmation EXCEPT when the favored side is laying >-170 at home.
AgentMemory.reasoning: 6 of 7 picks with >=15 net-rating gap won; the lone losses (10, 18) were both heavy NBA home chalk, suggesting the exception is price/role specific rather than the signal failing.

AgentMemory.rule: Heavy NBA home favorites at -170 or shorter are leaking even when model edge and net-rating gap are large. Picks 10 (DET -174 L) and 18 (DET -184 L) both lost despite 15-19 point net rating gaps and 10%+ model edges. Avoid or downweight NBA home chalk priced -170 or steeper; prefer the road dog side when the model edge is similar.
AgentMemory.reasoning: Two clean losses on heavy NBA home chalk with strong model+net-rating support. Small sample but consistent with the broader plus-money dog outperformance pattern from rules #4 and #7.

AgentMemory.rule: MLB run-differential gap (team rpg vs opponent oppRpg >=1.5, or run-production gap >=1.5 rpg between sides) is a reliable non-pitcher independent confirmation signal. Picks 34 (WAS rpg gap W), 35 (ATL run-prevention W), 37 (CWS 2.3 rpg gap W), 38 (WAS 5.54 rpg W), 41 (ATH rpg gap W), 43 (SF 2.17 rpg gap W) all won when this signal was the primary confirmation. The lone clear loss (pick 39 WAS as -142 chalk with rpg gap) suggests caution at heavier chalk prices. Prefer plus-money or short-chalk (<-145) MLB picks where this gap exists.
AgentMemory.reasoning: 6 of 7 picks citing team-level rpg differential as the primary non-pitcher confirmation won, several at plus money. This is the kind of independent signal rule #2 demands and rule #11 hinted at as a non-pitcher alternative.

AgentMemory.rule: Heavy MLB chalk (-140 or shorter) on road favorites is leaking even with strong model edge and run-differential support. Picks 19 (TB -154 L), 30 (TB +116 L despite ace SP), 39 (WAS -142 L), 33 (TB -108 L) all lost despite robust independent confirmation. When MLB model edge is large, prefer the plus-money side or pass — avoid laying -140+ on road teams even with rpg/pitcher edges.
AgentMemory.reasoning: Pattern of MLB chalk losses across multiple confirmations. Aligns with broader plus-money dog outperformance in rules #7 and #4.

AgentDreamRun.notes: Initialized memory store. Key signals: market/prop model snapshots are losing at 38% across 1561 graded picks (material), and in-house pipeline sample is still tiny (8 shipped, 2 graded wins) so analyst-derived rules stay tentative.

Retired the overly-conservative pipeline-size caution (id 1) and the unvalidated wide-spread hypothesis (id 3). Added tentative patterns: plus-money model-edge dogs are winning, heavy NBA home favorites are leaking, and NBA prop OVERs are mediocre despite large model edges — reinforcing existing memory #2 about prop model underperformance.

Refined the plus-money dog pattern with a larger 10-5 sample and added bookSpread as an explicit independent-confirmation signal per rule #2. Retired the narrow NBA-heavy-favorite bias (rule #5) — its signal is better expressed via the requirement for independent confirmation. Added a WNBA-specific rule given 5-1 recent performance and a cautionary note about over-relying on ace-pitcher narratives for Pirates.

Retired the narrow Skenes correction and the older plus-money rule in favor of a generalized MLB ace-pitcher caution (0-4 on starter-only theses) and reinforced rule #7. Added a strong net-rating-gap confirmation pattern (6-2 across leagues) and flagged heavy NBA home chalk (-170+) as a leak even with large model edges.

Added an MLB run-differential rule (6-1 evidence) as a non-pitcher independent confirmation pathway, and a tentative caution against heavy MLB chalk where independent confirmation exists. Existing rules (especially #11, #12, #13) remain consistent with the new sample so no retirements.
